'''Jakarro's XS stock light freighter''' was an [[XS stock light freighter/Legends|''XS stock light freighter'']] owned by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] smuggler [[Jakarro]] during the [[Galactic War]]. After Jakarro and his droid companions received [[Death mark/Legends|death marks]] from the [[Order of Revan]], they teamed up with [[Theron Shan]] and [[Lana Beniko]] to uncover their conspiracy. After tracking them to [[Lehon/Legends|Rakata Prime]], Jakarro joined the assault on the [[Temple of the Ancients]], while Lana and Theron took the ship into orbit and monitored the events from there. The team then traveled the [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]], where after a prolonged period of hiding, Jakarro used the ship to destroy the assets of the [[Nova Blades]] pirates.<ref name="SWTOR" /> At some point following the [[Battle of Yavin 4 (Galactic War)|battle]] of [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]], Jakarro's droid, [[C2-D4]], installed a remote piloting system in his ship.<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jakarro's XS stock light freighter first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during the "Legacy of the Rakata" flashpoints and later reappears during the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' expansion.
